slides.texte_overlay:
what people notice about
you in the first 7 seconds

your posture

before you say a word, people read how you stand. relaxed shoulders and a level chin tell everyone you're comfortable, and that calm confidence spreads quickly.

your eyes

people notice whether you meet their eyes or look away. a warm look held one second longer than usual feels like genuine interest and quietly builds trust.

your pace

people pick up on whether you rush or move calmly. walking and talking a little slower than everyone else reads as quiet, steady confidence almost instantly.

your curiosity

people notice real curiosity in seconds, and it grows when you feed your mind a little every day. a curious face looks open, warm and easy to talk to.
slides.texte_sophia:
your curiosity

people notice curiosity straight away. the Sophia app turns learning into one short lesson a day, a planet or a painting, and it shows in how i talk, listen and smile.

slides.texte_overlay:
your hands

people notice what your hands are doing. open, relaxed hands look honest and calm, while hidden or fidgeting hands make others feel a little more guarded.
